data.one_liner: Memory storage extension for the stash API to store vaults and caches in-memory.
data.what_it_does: Provides an in-memory storage backend for the stash caching and vault API. Allows creating stores to hold typed data objects with support for capacities and event listeners.
use_when: You need fast in-memory caching or vault storage using the stash API
You want temporary data storage that does not persist across application restarts
avoid_when: You need data to persist on the device across app restarts
You are looking for persistent key-value or SQL storage solutions
strengths: Integrates with the stash ecosystem and event listeners
Supports generics for typed data vaults and caches
weaknesses: Data is lost when the app closes (in-memory only)
Requires learning the stash API semantics
